blockers: R1 remains open until transport action integers are decoded against the preceding active selection request into the sealed G2 semantic option representation, the deterministic loader passes tests on all approved episodes, and an independent review is recorded.
warnings: The daily host dataset is elite, rating-selected and capped; it is not an unbiased ladder sample.
Manifest scores are episode-level and must not be attributed to one seat or deck.
Replay action at step t belongs to the preceding active agent request, not the same observation record.
The top-level replay id is an internal UUID; the Kaggle episode id is the filename.
Transport action integers are not model-ready supervision until semantic decoding is proved.
approved_next_action: Implement a streaming, deterministic, lag-aligned semantic replay loader over the approved private sample; do not download additional episodes or begin training without a new decision.
